title: Sacred Pause Yoga Retreat
cardBlurb: Regulate your rhythm, soothe your system, and find your center in midlife.
tagline: A sanctuary for women over 40 to pause, breathe, and rewrite their next chapter.
body: Regulate your rhythm, soothe your system, and find your center in midlife — honoring your body's transition into its wisest, most radiant chapter.

The transition through perimenopause and menopause is not a subtraction. It is an invitation to rewrite your story, listen to your body's changing rhythm, and step into your wisest, most radiant chapter yet.
Together, we will use the medicine of conscious breath to soothe your nervous system, targeted yoga to bring harmony to your body, and the sacred ritual of cacao to open our hearts.
Every meal will be thoughtfully prepared to nourish and support you from the inside out.
Give yourself permission to fully drop in. Rest when you need to. Cry if it flows. Laugh deeply. Pause completely.
offerings: Daily yoga classes and conscious breath

Workshop: Introduction to Ayurveda for Midlife — discover how Ayurveda views the transition of menopause, and learn practical, daily rituals, herbs and dietary shifts to manage dryness, sleep disruption and temperature fluctuations
Sacred Cacao Ceremony and Heart Sharing
